## Pull request overview

Adds multi-view switching to the Console’s ObjectView by rendering an Airtable-style named-view tab bar when an object defines multiple `list_views`, and updates example app navigation to deep-link directly to specific views via `viewName`.

**Changes:**
- Added a view-type → icon mapping and a named-view tab bar in `apps/console` ObjectView.
- Updated CRM and TODO example navigation items to include `viewName` bindings for kanban/calendar routes.
- Tabs route via existing `handleViewChange` to `/view/:viewId` URLs for view switching.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/todo/objectstack.config.ts | Adds `viewName`-bound nav items (“Task Board”, “Calendar”) for `todo_task` views. |
| examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts | Adds/updates `viewName`-bound nav items (“Pipeline”, “Calendar”) for opportunity/event views. |
| apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx | Introduces a named-view tab bar with icons and routes tab clicks to view-specific URLs. |

These view switches are implemented as `<button>` elements but don’t set `type="button"`. In HTML the default is `submit`, which can trigger unintended form submissions if this component is ever rendered inside a `<form>`. Please explicitly set `type="button"` for these tab buttons.
```suggestion
                       <button
                         type="button"
```

The UI is presented as a tab bar, but the markup is just a pair of `<div>`s with plain buttons. For screen readers/keyboard users, consider using the existing Tabs component (Radix/Shadcn) or adding appropriate semantics (e.g., `role="tablist"` on the container, `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`, and keyboard navigation) so the control is announced and behaves like tabs.
